copy.tagline_en: Automate image generation and editing from templates via Rube MCP
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly need to produce large volumes of consistent marketing visuals

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过 Rube MCP 自动执行 Abyssale 平台的任务（如创建模板、生成图片等），并始终先搜索最新工具架构再操作。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 执行任何 Abyssale 相关任务时（如创建横幅、生成海报），它会主动搜索可用工具并检查连接状态后执行。

say.text: 帮我在Abyssale创建一个横幅模板。
say.note: 触发搜索工具和连接检查。

say.text: 用Abyssale批量生成社交媒体图片。
say.note: 会先确认Abyssale连接是否激活。

say.text: 在Abyssale中生成一张产品海报。
say.note: Claude会按照发现工具、连接、执行的流程操作。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude automates Abyssale tasks (e.g., create templates, generate images) via Rube MCP, always searching for current tool schemas first before executing.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you ask Claude to perform any Abyssale-related task (like creating a banner or generating a poster). It will first search for available tools and check connection status.

say_en.text: Create a banner template in Abyssale.
say_en.note: Triggers tool search and connection check.

say_en.text: Batch generate social media images in Abyssale.
say_en.note: Checks if Abyssale connection is active first.

say_en.text: Generate a product poster in Abyssale.
